summary: Major catalysts: (1) Norfolk Southern $85B merger - creates first truly transcontinental US railroad; expected close H1 2027; STB regulatory review ongoing with competition-impact concerns; mgmt projects ~35% reduction in handoff delays. (2) Q1 record: net income $1.7B (+5% YoY), EPS $2.87 (+6%), Q1 records on operating income and net income. Mgmt reiterated 2026 mid-single-digit reported EPS growth + further OR gains. (3) Next earnings est July 23, 2026. (4) Risks: STB requesting more competition/market-share data on the merger.
